<td style="width:11%;vertical-align:top;text-align:left"><span style="font-weight:bold">Item&#8201;8.01</span></td>
<td style="vertical-align:top;text-align:left"> <p style=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold;text-align:left">Other Events. </p></td></tr></table> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Core University Living Real Estate Income Trust (the &#8220;Company,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;our,&#8221; or &#8220;us&#8221;) is filing this Current Report on Form <span style="white-space:nowrap">8-K</span> in order to provide an update regarding our net asset value (&#8220;NAV&#8221;). </p> <p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">November&#160;1, 2026 Transaction Price </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The transaction price as of November&#160;1, 2026 for each of our share classes is equal to such share class&#8217;s NAV per share as of September&#160;30, 2026. A calculation of the NAV per share is set forth below. </p> <p style="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:bold">September&#160;30, 2026 NAV Per Share </p> <p style="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Our NAV per share is calculated in accordance with valuation guidelines approved by our board of trustees. Our NAV per share, which is updated as of the last calendar day of each month, is made available to our shareholders on our website at&#160;www.culreit.com. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Certain transactions or events may have occurred since September&#160;30, 2026 that could have a material impact on our NAV per share, upon which our transaction price is based. Our total NAV presented in the following tables includes the aggregate NAV of our outstanding common shares. The following table provides a breakdown of the major components of our total NAV as of September&#160;30, 2026 ($ and shares in thousands): </p> <p style="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&#160;</p>

</table> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We include no discounts to our NAV for the illiquid nature of our common shares, including the limitations on our shareholders&#8217; ability to have their shares repurchased under our share repurchase plan and our ability to suspend our share repurchase plan at any time. Our NAV generally does not consider exit costs (e.g., selling costs and commissions and debt prepayment penalties related to the sale of a property) that would likely be incurred if our assets and liabilities were liquidated or sold. While we may use market pricing concepts to value individual components of our NAV, our <span style="white-space:nowrap">per-share</span> NAV is not derived from the market pricing information of real estate funds listed on stock exchanges. </p> <p style="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Our NAV is not a representation, warranty or guarantee that: (i)&#160;we would fully realize our NAV upon a sale of our assets, the sale of our company to a third party or a liquidation of our company; (ii)&#160;our common shares would trade at our per share NAV on a national securities exchange; and (iii)&#160;a shareholder would be able to realize the per share NAV if such shareholder attempted to sell his or her shares to a third party. </p>
